facts.value: Research students develop advanced skills in designing and conducting research; skills applicable to a variety of careers in academia, business and government.

At the Kemmy Business School (KBS) you’ll find a vibrant research environment with faculty who are leaders in their field, and where there is a strong focus on students engaging in translational research.
The Graduate Research Centre of the Kemmy Business School (KBS) is situated in the Foundation Building at the University of Limerick.
four cutting-edge research themes under the umbrella theme of 'Organisation Science & Public Policy'
Students can apply and register at any stage of the academic year for a research degree, both part-time and full-time.
Applications are considered monthly during the academic year.
Many KBS graduates take up senior academic posts or secure positions with government or private sector organisations.
A research degree from the KBS will give you an opportunity to make an impact.
